quote: We cast a suite of information extraction tasks into a text-to-triple translation framework.

We report precision, recall, and F1 score using a confidence threshold optimized on the development set. Second, we compute a precision-recall curve by evaluating the performance of the systems at different confidence thresholds. Third, we also measure the area under the PR curve (AUC) to evaluate the overall performance of a system.
